_comment: WO-5 step one, the rented-GPU timing session. TIMING ONLY - NOT A RESULT OF RECORD. Prepared
2026-10-07 under D-050 (the owner chose to prepare the RunPod Secure Cloud RTX 4090 session);
the spend itself still needs the owner's explicit approval at the session (D-047). Nothing is
evaluated, exported or logged to MLflow by the run; the fit is interrupted after the budget. ADR
0020's cell A on cuda: hidden 128, 2 blocks, 4 heads, feed-forward 512, dropout 0.2, history
100, sampled softmax with 1,024 negatives, 512 examples per step, Adam 1e-3, seed 42, the
objective of record (strict-prefix-final-position-v1), the full dataset, early stopping off.
Timed by `python -m src.training.sasrec_timing run`: 600 s of steady-state stepping after 20
warm-up steps (the WO-4 method's warm-up, excluded), then the steady mean x 38,554 steps per
pass. epochs is 5, the cell's ceiling, only so no pass boundary can end the fit before the
budget does. The protocol hash is the no-cohort hash of the full split.train, pinned so a
machine reading different data fails rather than times it. References: the 2026-10-05 CPU and
mps timings of this exact step.
result_status: timing only - not a result of record

cpu.basis: measured: 2,000 steps, full dataset, Mac CPU, one thread, 2026-10-05

mps.basis: measured: the same 2,000 steps on mps, 2026-10-05
